_comment: Demetri's voice: calm, methodical, protective. Light Jamaican expressions, used respectfully.

select.speaker: player
select.text: Contain smart, not fast. Let's go clear the Grid.

z0_intro_p.speaker: player
z0_intro_p.text: Ready when you are, Oracle. Mi deh yah.

z0_outro_p.speaker: player
z0_outro_p.text: Phishing at the gate. Mi soon come.

z1_intro_p.speaker: player
z1_intro_p.text: From line says Northwind. Let's see who actually knocked.

z1_o3_p.speaker: player
z1_o3_p.text: Two got through, one caught. Mira opened hers. Easy now, one step at a time.

z1_outro_p.speaker: player
z1_outro_p.text: Lure's gone. But Mira clicked Enable Content, so something ran. Follow it, don't chase it.

z2_intro_p.speaker: player
z2_intro_p.text: Process trees. Every child has a parent. Let's find the one that don't belong.

z2_o2_p.speaker: player
z2_o2_p.text: Why would Word spawn PowerShell? Somebody's knocking.

z2_outro_p.speaker: player
z2_outro_p.text: updchk.exe, calling stat-sync.example. Memory captured first. That's how we keep the story.

z3_intro_p.speaker: player
z3_intro_p.text: If I were planting roots, I'd hide them where nobody looks twice. Baseline says otherwise.

z3_outro_p.speaker: player
z3_outro_p.text: Two roots pulled. And Mira was local admin. Fix the cause, not just the symptom.

z4_intro_p.speaker: player
z4_intro_p.text: LSASS. If they touched it, every password on that box is theirs. Let's check the access rights.

z4_o6_p.speaker: player
z4_o6_p.text: t.brooks. One printer fix and the admin keys were sitting in memory. Wah gwaan, Tom.

z4_outro_p.speaker: player
z4_outro_p.text: Reset and hardened. They got a head start, so we watch where those keys go.

z5_intro_p.speaker: player
z5_intro_p.text: Same commands IT runs. Different desk, different hour. That's the tell.

z5_outro_p.speaker: player
z5_outro_p.text: Five servers answered. Mi know where dem a go next.

z6_intro_p.speaker: player
z6_intro_p.text: Map every bridge first. Then we close them all together, quiet and clean.

z6_o6_p.speaker: player
z6_o6_p.text: Jump server to the vault. Steady. We don't flinch now.

z6_outro_p.speaker: player
z6_outro_p.text: Bridges down. But the vault is still whispering to someone.

z7_intro_p.speaker: player
z7_intro_p.text: Machines keep time better than people. Listen for the rhythm.

z7_o6_p.speaker: player
z7_o6_p.text: ledger_q3.7z. They're packing the family silver.

z7_outro_p.speaker: player
z7_outro_p.text: All channels cut in one move. Now we see what they got away with.

z8_intro_p.speaker: player
z8_intro_p.text: Preserve, contain, eradicate, recover. Same as always. Just faster.

z8_o4_p.speaker: player
z8_o4_p.text: Ransomware armed beside the backups. Not today.

z8_flag_p.speaker: player
z8_flag_p.text: Seal holds. Flag's ours. Network's safe. Respect, Oracle.

z0_node_wall.speaker: player
z0_node_wall.text: Know who you're facing before you face them.

z1_node_mailgw.speaker: player
z1_node_mailgw.text: Headers read bottom-up. Let's see where this really came from.

z1_node_helpdesk.speaker: player
z1_node_helpdesk.text: Users are sensors. 'Nothing happened' usually means something did.

z1_node_sandbox.speaker: player
z1_node_sandbox.text: Let the sandbox open it so nobody else has to.

z1_node_vendor.speaker: player
z1_node_vendor.text: What does normal look like for this vendor?

z2_node_proxy.speaker: player
z2_node_proxy.text: Whatever ran had to fetch something. The proxy remembers.

z2_node_intel.speaker: player
z2_node_intel.text: Normal parents, suspicious parents. Good reference.

z3_node_ws0142.speaker: player
z3_node_ws0142.text: What starts when Mira logs in?

z3_node_sched.speaker: player
z3_node_sched.text: Tasks tell you who made them and when. Read the author.

z3_node_hive.speaker: player
z3_node_hive.text: Run keys. Old trick, still works.

z3_node_gpo.speaker: player
z3_node_gpo.text: The baseline turns 'looks odd' into 'not approved'.

z4_node_ws0142.speaker: player
z4_node_ws0142.text: Fifty megs written and deleted. That's a dump, and it left.

z4_node_helpdesk.speaker: player
z4_node_helpdesk.text: Who logged in here besides Mira?

z4_node_hardening.speaker: player
z4_node_hardening.text: LSA Protection postponed. For a printer. Hmm.

z5_node_ueba.speaker: player
z5_node_ueba.text: An admin account on a finance desk. Tom wouldn't do that.

z5_node_dc.speaker: player
z5_node_dc.text: Somebody asked the DC for a map.

z5_node_netflow.speaker: player
z5_node_netflow.text: One source, many destinations, seconds apart. A sweep.

z5_node_itops.speaker: player
z5_node_itops.text: Check the calendar before you accuse anybody.

z6_node_fscore.speaker: player
z6_node_fscore.text: ADMIN$ write, then a service. PsExec style.

z6_node_jump.speaker: player
z6_node_jump.text: Follow the source addresses, hop by hop.

z6_node_netpol.speaker: player
z6_node_netpol.text: Allowed paths. Anything else is a broken bridge.

z6_node_backup.speaker: player
z6_node_backup.text: They're touching backups. I don't like where this goes.

z7_node_proxy.speaker: player
z7_node_proxy.text: A database server browsing the web? No sah.

z7_node_dnsres.speaker: player
z7_node_dnsres.text: Long, random names in TXT lookups. Data riding in DNS.

z7_node_lab.speaker: player
z7_node_lab.text: The config shows their plan B. And plan C.

z7_node_vault.speaker: player
z7_node_vault.text: One approved destination. Everything else is noise or theft.

z8_node_vault.speaker: player
z8_node_vault.text: How much left the building? Let's scope it.

z8_node_backup.speaker: player
z8_node_backup.text: Encryptor beside the backups. Clock's ticking.

z8_node_lab.speaker: player
z8_node_lab.text: Memory says svc_backup is still live. Noted.

z8_node_core.speaker: player
z8_node_core.text: The seal. Key's in memory. Let's lock it down.
